product.name: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses
product.description: Everyday sunglasses with a camera, open-ear speakers, and a voice assistant. You take photos and video hands-free, listen to music, and ask the assistant questions. They look like ordinary glasses and start shipping this autumn.

brief.targetMarket: people who already buy premium sunglasses and want a camera that is not a phone
brief.geography: US, UK, Canada, Australia, and parts of Europe

actual.source: Launch: Ray-Ban Meta glasses were announced at Meta Connect on 2023-09-27 and began shipping 2023-10-17 at $299 (EssilorLuxottica and Meta product pages). 2024 sales: Mark Zuckerberg told staff that more than 1 million units sold in 2024 (The Verge, 2025-01-30). Cumulative: EssilorLuxottica CEO Francesco Milleri said more than 2 million had been sold by the 2025-02-13 earnings call (UploadVR, 2025-02-13; Reuters, 2025-02-13). The prior Ray-Ban Stories generation sold fewer than 300,000 in a longer window (Wall Street Journal memo, cited by UploadVR). Addressable market of 10 million is a stated assumption: buyers of premium sunglasses in the first launch countries, not a company figure. Month 3 (about 800,000) is the pre-2024 remainder implied by 2 million cumulative minus a bit over 1 million in 2024, rounded down. Month 15 (about 2 million, February 2025) is the sourced cumulative milestone.
topComplaints: Discomfort wearing them for long sessions
Voice assistant was limited at launch
Open-ear audio leaks in quiet rooms
actual.notes: Adoption is cumulative units as a share of the 10 million addressable market above. The product was a commercial success relative to earlier camera glasses: about 2 million units by February 2025, and EssilorLuxottica called it a great success and raised production plans. Price stayed at a $299 entry point and was not the thing that held it back. The budget lines in the brief are assumptions for the finance layer and are not scored. The month-12 point (1.5 million) sits between the sourced 2024 run-rate and the February 2025 cumulative; it is an interpolation, not a separate disclosure.
